comment: Funny and interesting guy. Lectures were super captivating. Tough grader and no clear guidelines. Even if he follows the guidelines for an assignment, he will have other issues. He is a subjective grader in my opinion, so participate as much as possible to get on his good side. I don't love professors like that, but he is very nice and personable.

Dr.Hayter is a captivating professor. His lectures are engaging, and I always enjoy them. Participation truly matters in this class; don't take it lightly. It is very easy to bring up your grade as long as you show him you put in effort. There is a group project at the end, which I didn't find the grading criteria super clear, so work hard on that.

He is a fascinating and well-rounded professor, with lots of life experience that enriches the course. You will learn about leadership in ways you didn't think were related. Very funny and makes you think hard, his honesty can be surprising. You won't know your grade until the end of the course because he doesn't use Blackboard.

His lectures are very engaging and I always laugh at least once a day in his class. He is super direct, which kind of makes him intimidating, but he's actually really nice. His grading is very lenient and the workload is very manageable. There's also always a curve.

Dr. Hayter is so funny and makes class entertaining and relatable. However, his grading was very harsh and he never put grades on blackboard. The grade is based off very few assignments and it was difficult to know what he wanted on tests/assignments.
Dr. Hayter is a hoot. He will chop it up with you. Easily the best first-year Jepson professor. Take his class. You don't really need to do the readings just know what they're about.
This guy is sick, a lot of work and is a tough grader though. He also is a very subjective grader.

Such an enjoyable class, I looked forward to going. I didn't do any of the readings, he doesn't ask about them in class and it was fine but then on the final paper you must know the readings. The topics are so interesting that you end up wanting participate but it is part of your grade. Couple of easy quizzes, tough midterm, and a final paper.

I loved Dr. Hayter's class. He has high expectations but definitely prepares you for the rest of your college courses. Be prepared to do a lot of work but it is not too difficult if you try and ask for help, when needed. Dr. Hayter is also very funny and knowledgeable. He will keep you awake during 9am's and treats all of his students with respect.

For an FYS course, his class had significantly more readings and work. He assigns a lot of readings that aren't also necessary. He grades papers harshly and while he gives feedback, he can be pretty harsh. The midterm is hard, but manageable. The final research paper involves significantly more work than other FYS classes and he expects a lot.

prof hayter was my favorite this semester. even tho my fys was at 9:00am it was easy to come to class cuz of how engaging his lectures were. i'm not the best writer but he is willing to work with you as much as you need outside of class and will walk you through any papers. LOTS OF READING!!!! peak was like 75-100 pages after a class.

Julian Hayter - what a guy. His lectures are genuinely so amazing. He's very passionate about the material and his office hours are always good and helpful. He really wants to see you succeed so he's really flexible with due dates and even allows re-writes. He assigns a lot of reading but it's never too overbearing. If you're able to, take him

Dr. Hayter is the goat and definitely sold me on continuing to explore Jepson. Totally recommend - he is down to earth, charismatic, and has a strong ability to examine nuances and tie them back to grander motifs of the course. Clear and fair about grading policy.

Best prof I've had at UR. Hayter is amazing and so knowledgeable. He's always hilarious and energetic, which makes it worth it for it being a 9am class. Lecture heavy but the class is interesting. Quizzes here and there and one big group project at the end of the semester. Wasn't difficult but make sure to take notes in class and do the readings.

Dr. Hayter single-handedly made me want to major in Leadership Studies. His lectures blend elements of ted talks with the aura of a motivational speaker. He is highly knowledgeable, funny, and always willing to answer questions or engage in cool thought experiments. Highly energetic, and would definitely recommend. This guy doesn't miss.
Professor Hayter is the most engaging professor I have had at UR. He is not an easy grader at all, but if you participate in class and stay on top of the reading you should be fine.

An absolutely amazing professor. Asked for a lot from his students, but not in a way that was overwhelming. Really cared about his students and rewarded them for hard work. The best professor that I have had in college and highly recommend taking a class with him if you have the chance.

He is an absolutely amazing professor! If you have the chance to take one of his classes, please do! He really cares about his students and makes sure that they grow as students and people. He will challenge you to think about your beliefs but is always willing to help you. Put in the work and you will do fine in the class.

I enjoyed Dr.Hayter so much! This man is a character! The justice course is designed to make you think! Don't come in expecting to know all the answers, because he has not problem challenging your thoughts. His slides are very helpful and they essentially are the study guides for every test and what he likes to call "quizzams". I enjoyed this class

This man has set such a high bar for any professor after him. Even a year in, I genuinely think he is my all time favorite professor. He's engaging and makes you want to do well in his class. You do have to work for it and participate, but it is so worth it. Do yourself a favor and take his class.

This was my only 9am class and I attended hungover many times without a single complaint. I loved this course and Hayter is such a dynamic and engaging professor. I learned so much, even outside of the curriculum which the students helped design. Class discussions often went on tangents but they were intelligent and thought provoking. Loved it!!!

FAV UR PROF. He really engages his students. Class is challenging but he is the kind of prof you want to work hard for. Does a great job of incorporating current topics and facilitating discussion. SUPER knowledgable. Use his office hours!! Gives great feed back on papers.

Second class with Dr. Hayter, just as rewarding. He is an awesome professor, my favorite at UR. You'll have to read, pay close attention in class, and take good notes, but if you put in the work, you'll succeed. He has very fair expectations. Justice is a great course overall, and if you can take it with Dr. Hayter, do so.

Incredible person, lots of energy every day in lecture, and makes class a joy. This class is not an easy A, but if you put in the work, it is achievable. Regardless, Dr. Hayter's personality, insight, and ability to connect with students makes this course well worth it. Highly recommend.

Dr. Hayter is the best educator I have ever encountered. He is definitley a hard professor, but taking a class from him is completely worth it. Even though it is at 9 am, he is always wide awake and cracking jokes. Highly reccomend taking his class even if you are not majoring in leadership. He's an amazing guy!
Professor Hayter is easily one of the best professors I've had. Be sure to stay up on the readings for the quizzes. Tough but fair grader on assignments and his lectures are very entertaining.

Probably because of his stint on 60 Minutes, Dr. Hayter is one of the most well-known professors at richmond. He's easily one of my favorite professors and favorite people on campus. He REALLY appreciates students who participate in class. Seek him out during his office hours for great conversation about class related topics and life in general.

Very personable and takes time to know about each student and remembers details about them! Hilarious but also stays on topic and makes you think critically about leaders you thought you knew so well.

Very easygoing, GREAT discussions. Definitely one of the toughest teaches I've had, but that's what you get with Jepson. Good feedback, tough grader, worth the class, though. Nice guy, thinks he knows everything, but he sure does know a lot!

My favorite professor at Richmond so far, incredibly engaging in lectures, can tell he loves the subject matter and teaching it. Good amount of reading, but it's definitely possible to get around it. He expects people to talk in class, but he makes discussions interesting enough that it's not a chore. Can't say enough good things about him.

My favorite professor at UR! He's funny, passionate, and simply amazing! His engaging lectures defied both my previous dislike for humanities and the universal  college students' tendency to fall asleep in 9am classes. His class would challenge you (lots of reading!), but he offers rewrite and really helpful feedback so your grades won't suffer.

Dr. Hayter was my favorite professor this semester! He's hilarious and will keep you awake during 9ams. You will have 3 papers, two short and one final paper. He has high expectations but is clear about what he wants. Definitely go to his office hours if you need help; he is very approachable. Looking forward to taking more classes with him.

Dr. Hayter is by far the best professor I've had at UR! He's hilarious and super witty. Definitely keeps you awake at 9am! He can also make any topic interesting and his passion for the subject resonates through his lectures. He assigns a lot of reading, but you can get away with reading book reviews to participate in class. Would take again!

Dr. Hayter changed the way I think about so many things and his enthusiasm shows during lectures. He loves seeing debates in class and it's always interesting. Participation matters, but it's so interesting you'll want to do the readings. He's so articulate and well-versed. I want to take more classes with him! He gives such good feedback on papers

Dr. Hayter is engaging, funny, and cares about students' development as writers and thinkers. He makes an effort with each kid and comes to class full of energy every day. Such a great professor; I would take any class he teaches.

Dr. Hayter was a great leadership teacher!! He is very knowledgeable and is clear when teaching information. He expects a lot from students but I always look forward to going to class. Hayter always keeps class interesting and has a good sense of humor!

best professor ever! i looked forward to his class every day, despite it being in the morning. willing to negotiate grades with you, incredibly smart, hilarious, and just awesome. highly recommend any of his classes. hes the bomb diggity!

Dr. Hayter is the best teacher at UR!! Super smart and really wants his students to learn. He expects a lot from you, but he makes his requirements very clear in every class. Students leave his classroom with new interests and knowledge about important topics every person should know about.

Hayter is the man. He will inspire you, challenge you, and you'll want to be his best friend. He's a really smart guy and loves to teach. Don't be fooled, it's not an easy A but you will get so much out of having him as a professor. Take his class.
